prompts.playersA:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: a finished PORTRAIT ATLAS for a basketball game. Match the attached approved picture's drawing style very closely: complete handsome/appealing but individual human faces, coherent anatomy and warm skin lighting, crisp dark contour lines, painted comic/sports illustration cel tones, beautifully shaped natural eyes, full integrated noses/lips and organic hair. Each head is drawn as ONE coherent finished illustration. NO separate feature components, no masks, no low-poly faces, no flattened skin, no huge staring eyes, no photo/3D look. Do not make every head square/angular: include oval, broad, narrow, round and softer faces with diverse individual eyes, brows, noses, lips and jawlines.
Layout: EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, SIXTEEN equally sized front-facing head-and-shoulders portraits in a single image. Portrait sheet aspect ratio about 3:4. NO gaps/gutters, frames, labels, numbers, text, logos or watermark. Each cell fills its own rectangle edge-to-edge with a warm dusty taupe studio backdrop like the reference; all hair and chins fully inside their cell. Same head scale and crop as the reference, shoulders and upper neckline visible. No hands. Sixteen clearly different FICTIONAL adults, not recognizable celebrities. All are male basketball players aged 20-30, wearing the same simple purple basketball jersey with cream trim as the reference. Row 1: four East Asian looks, mostly clean-shaven, different head shapes: thick swept black hair, spiky crop, straight fringe, wavy middle part. Row 2: four Black looks ranging medium-brown to very dark skin, different faces, with short afro, short locs, cornrows, and close crop; one neat goatee, one short full beard and two clean-shaven. Row 3: four white/European looks, varied pale/fair/olive tones, one redhead with beard, one blond clean-shaven, one dark-haired stubble, one brown curly hair and short beard. Row 4: four medium/brown looks inspired by South Asian, Middle Eastern, Latino, and Pacific Islander backgrounds, all distinct: two clean-shaven, one mustache, one beard. Athletic people with natural healthy facial volume and relaxed/confident expressions, exactly like the approved image.
